- Hiking Boots or Trail Shoes (for Diamond Head)
- Water Shoes (for Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay and Kayaking)
- Comfortable Walking Shoes (for Pearl Harbor and Departure travel)
- Flip-flops or Sandals (for the beach and resort wear)

**Accessories & Gear**
- Camera (for Snorkeling, Road Trip, and Luau)
- Sunglasses
- Wide-brimmed Hat or Sun Cap
- Reusable Water Bottle (for Hiking and Road Trip)
- Daypack/Small Backpack (for carrying essentials on excursions)
- Beach Towel (unless hotel provides)

**Toiletries & Health**
- Sunscreen (Reef-safe, high SPF for water activities)
- Insect Repellent (for Hiking and outdoor evenings)
- Personal Toiletries (Toothbrush, deodorant, shampoo, etc.)
- Basic First Aid Kit (Band-aids, antiseptic wipes)
